request.text: What is the voltage on VM1?

solution: *** Solution by TINA assisted by AI ***
At first we calculate the total resistance between the generator nodes (VS1)
R3 and R2 connected in series so Rb=R3+R2=1Ohm+1Ohm=2Ohm
Rb and R1 connected in series so Ra=Rb+R1=2Ohm+1Ohm=3Ohm
Now we calculate the voltage on R3
We know that the voltage between VS1 nodes is 5V.
The components Rb,R1 connected in series.
The voltage between this components starting and ending node is 5V
Rb is in the voltage divider so the voltage on Rb is Rb/Ra*5V = 3.33V
The components R3,R2 connected in series.
The voltage between this components starting and ending node is 3.33V
R3 is in the voltage divider so the voltage on R3 is R3/Rb*3.33V = 1.67V
To answer the original question: because the VM1 voltmeter connected to R3 parallel so the voltage on VM1 is 1.67V
We have considered also the sign of the voltage on R3
